评审结果：14 项（consensus 8 / disputed 0 / solo 6；Important 14 / Nit 0 / Pre-existing 0；已过滤 0）

1. [consensus] [Important] Discount reservation is started but never awaited
   证据：src/checkout.ts:18 `        this.reserveDiscount(discount.id);`
   `this.reserveDiscount(discount.id)` returns a promise that checkout ignores. The payment charge can complete (and the method return) before the `usedCount` UPDATE lands, so the order may be charged while the reservation is lost or still racing another checkout. If `discounts.reserve` rejects, the rejection is unhandled and can terminate the process while the customer has already been charged. Await the reservation and handle its failure before charging (or reserve after a successful charge).
   发现者：correctness, security, design；voter：valid — The call at line 18 is not awaited, so checkout proceeds to charge while the reservation UPDATE is in flight; a reserve rejection would also be unhandled.

2. [consensus] [Important] Discount cache is keyed only by code, bypassing per-user and staleness checks
   证据：src/discount.ts:19 `    if (this.cache.has(code)) return this.cache.get(code)!;`
   `lookup` returns any cached entry before re-running the `usedCount`, `expiresAt`, and `ownerId` checks. Because a positive entry is cached after a non-owner lookup, the campaign owner (who should be rejected) and any later user receive the discount on a cache hit. The cached object also snapshots `usedCount`, so a long-lived repository keeps applying a code after it expires or reaches `maxUses`. Cache the raw row or key by `(code, userId)` with TTL/invalidation, and revalidate cached entries.
   发现者：correctness, security, design；voter：valid — The cache hit returns at line 19 before the usedCount, expiry, and ownerId checks, and the cached row retains a stale usedCount, so later lookups bypass revalidation.

3. [consensus] [Important] reserve() discards the conditional UPDATE result, so maxUses enforcement fails silently
   证据：src/discount.ts:43 `      "UPDATE discount_codes SET usedCount = usedCount + 1 WHERE id = $1 AND usedCount < maxUses",`
   The UPDATE only increments while `usedCount < maxUses`, but `reserve` returns `void` and throws away whatever the query reports. When the guard matches zero rows (another checkout consumed the last use, or the cache supplied a stale `usedCount`), the method resolves normally and checkout has already applied the discount and charged the customer. Return/expose the affected-row count and fail or re-price the checkout when the reservation does not take.
   发现者：correctness, security, design；voter：valid — reserve() ignores the UPDATE result; when the conditional update matches zero rows it still resolves as success while the discounted charge has already proceeded.

4. [solo] [Important] Expiry is evaluated at start-of-day UTC, contradicting the whole-local-day comment
   证据：src/discount.ts:34 `    if (expiresAt <= new Date()) return null;`
   `new Date(`${expiresAt}T00:00:00Z`)` plus `expiresAt <= new Date()` marks a date-only code invalid from 00:00:00 UTC on the named day, so it cannot be used during its final calendar day; using `Z` also ignores the local day the comment promises. A malformed `expiresAt` yields `Invalid Date`, for which the comparison is false, so the code never expires. Compare against the end of the intended local day (e.g., next-day local midnight with `<`) and reject unparseable dates.
   发现者：correctness；voter：valid — The 00:00Z construction plus <= rejects a date-only code from the start of the named day, contradicting the whole-local-day comment; an Invalid Date compares false.

5. [consensus] [Important] Per-item rounding drifts from order-level percentage semantics
   证据：src/checkout.ts:29 `      const discounted = Math.round(item.priceCents * item.qty * (1 - percentOff / 100));`
   Rounding each line independently can charge a different amount than rounding the order discount once. For example, 3 x 333 cents at 10% produces `Math.round(299.7) = 300` per line, for 900 cents, while 10% off the 999-cent order is 99.9 cents and rounds to 899. The per-line error is up to half a cent per line and is untested. Compute the discount on `originalTotal` and round once, or document and test line-level rounding.
   发现者：correctness, design；voter：valid — Per-line rounding differs from rounding the order total: 3 x 333 at 10% gives 300 per line (900 total) versus 899 when rounded once, and that case asserts no amount.

6. [consensus] [Important] Test asserts a property that the checkout result never contains
   证据：src/checkout.test.ts:29 `    expect(res.total).toBeUndefined();`
   The result union has `status`, `txId`/`error`, and `chargedCents`; it has no `total`. Under tsc/ts-jest this is a TS2339 compile error, and where types are stripped the assertion passes vacuously, so the "applies a discount" test never verifies the discount (and hides the per-line rounding behavior).    发现者：correctness, design, test-integrity；voter：valid — The result union has no total member, so res.total is a TS2339 error; at runtime it is undefined and the assertion passes without verifying the discount.
